steps.observable_result: The current WorkflowHub session has read the portable package and the current decision-log.md.

If current facts already make behavior precise, research is recorded as skipped with the reason; otherwise the existing spec-research package returns executed findings or a truthful unavailable result, and only durable facts needed by spec.md are carried forward.

Only when material specification ambiguity remains, the unique spec-clarify owner presents one batch of independent questions and performs one real ask → wait → matching user reply → resume cycle; dependent questions move to a later batch, the card/round/hash are checked, and no reply or wrong reply remains incomplete rather than inferred.
spec.md describes the current product behavior from the decision log, conditional research facts, and any confirmed specification clarification.
Deletion, narrowing, and reuse decisions are reflected directly in spec.md.
Problem, scope, value, alternatives, and product direction are checked and reflected in spec.md.
For UI scope, buildUiProjectInitFact records the new/legacy project boundary, Design.md revision, component/style boundary, and missing facts; non-UI scope records not applicable.
For UI scope, deriveDesignSourceReadiness emits a Screen Read Map with bindable, not_bindable, or unknown facts for the existing plan-design-review; no-design facts remain non-gating.

Before the existing plan-design-review, UI scope uses buildShortUiDesignPrompt for four short fields and validateUiDesignLoopFact to preserve preview, prompt, external-design return/cancel/not-returned/version-mismatch, and human-confirmation facts; non-UI scope records why it is not applicable in spec.md.
The current spec.md contains requirements, flows, states, boundaries, FR, AC, non-goals, and deferred work.

One independent findings-review adapter run of the current spec.md is recorded under quality/reviews/results/; provider, transport and unavailable facts stay honest and this review is advice, not pass permission.
Valid findings are repaired in spec.md; rejected or deferred findings retain their reasons in the current material or quality facts.

The existing spec-analyze profile checks the original requirement and decision-log against the complete current spec, user flow, states, FR/AC, boundaries, non-goals, and actual evidence; valid gaps are repaired in this stage and a plain-language six-field summary is produced before handoff.

The current WorkflowHub session gives a plain-language handoff explaining what the spec does, key flows, boundaries, research/clarify facts, review outcome, risks, and the next stage; the comment is notification, not a gate.
当前主会话在 build-spec 结束执行轻量 stage-reflection，输出判断层记录；复盘失败只记录事实，不阻断 stage 或 close。
